$comment: Feature catalog for testing agents: dotnet run scripts/Screenshot.cs -- --list. 'page' is the @page template the entry covers (checked by FeatureCatalogTests); 'route' is what gets opened, where {account:<name>} is replaced by the id of the account with that name in the nav menu. Guest accounts: Cash 1, Loan 1, Investments (stock/ETF), Bond 1.

features.description: Dashboard: net worth, balances and summary cards.
Assets overview and distribution.
Liabilities (loans) overview.
Investments dashboard across all investment accounts.
All transactions of all accounts, grouped by day, with search and filters. There is no add-transaction dialog here; see account-add-entry.
Detected recurring payments (subscriptions).
Cash flow forecast: projected balance chart and horizon deltas.
Balance alerts and their configuration.
Automation: transaction labeling rules.
Account details of the cash (currency) account Cash 1: balance chart and history.
Account details of the loan account Loan 1.
Account details of the stock/ETF investment account (named Investments; also called Stock 1): holdings, trades, appreciation.
Account details of the bond account Bond 1.
Add transaction (add entry) dialog, open on the Cash 1 account. Adding transactions happens on account details pages, not on the Transactions page.
Add transaction (buy/sell trade) dialog, open on the Investments stock account.
Manage (rename/delete) the Cash 1 account.
CSV import for the Cash 1 account.
CSV export for the Cash 1 account.
Add a new account.
User settings.
Connect an MCP client (AI assistant) to the account.
